summary: Change Agents Corporation (formerly Avalon GloboCare; Nasdaq: CHGA) filed an 8-K reporting a $250,000 promissory note issued to Harllon Holdings LLC on November 4, 2026, with a $75,000 original issue discount, repayable January 1, 2027 at $325,000 and prepayable December 1, 2026 at $312,000. The company also agreed to issue 150,000 unregistered shares to consultants under Section 4(a)(2) and appointed Chief Strategy Officer Luisa Ingargiola as principal executive officer pending a permanent CEO, with no additional compensation. Mechanics are financing and interim-officer items, not a special situation; watch dilution and liquidity.
